text: A very special island is inhabited only by angels and devils. Angels always tell the truth, and devils always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Ethan, and Amelia. Ethan told you that if Amelia is an angel then Ethan is an angel. In a statement by Amelia: "Ethan is a devil if and only if Ethan is an angel". So who is an angel and who is a devil? (Format your answer like: "Ethan is a angel/devil, and Amelia is a angel/devil")
